title: Open product neighborhoods of compact subsets
statement: Let $X,Y$ be topological spaces and $K\subseteq X$, $L\subseteq Y$ compact subsets with their subspace topologies [def-kun-subspace-topology], where compact means that every cover by relatively open subsets has a finite subcover. Give $X\times Y$ the product topology. If $W\subseteq X\times Y$ is open and $K\times L\subseteq W$, then there exist open subsets $U\subseteq X$, $V\subseteq Y$ with $K\subseteq U$, $L\subseteq V$, and $U\times V\subseteq W$. No separation or nonemptiness hypotheses are imposed.
